english.title: Contravene provision of EU Regulation at time of killing animal (other than relating to pain, distress and suffering)
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[contravened]_
(B)_[caused or permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to contravene]_

a provision of Council Regulation (EC) No 1099/2009 of 24 September 2009 on the protection of animals at the time of killing, namely

(C)_[Article 5(1) relating to checks on stunning]_
(D)_[Article 5(2) relating to checks on animals killed in accordance with religious rites]_
(E)_[Article 6(1) and (2) relating to standard operating procedures]_
(F)_[Article 7(1) relating to level of competence]_
(G)_[Article 7(3) relating to killing of fur animals]_
(H)_[Article 8 relating to sale of restraining or stunning equipment]_
(I)_[Article 9(1) relating to maintenance of restraining and stunning equipment]_
(J)_[Article 9(2) relating to back-up stunning equipment]_
(K)_[Article 9(3) relating to placing of animals in restraining equipment]_
(L)_[Article 12 relating to meat imported from third countries]_
(M)_[Article 14(1) and Annex II relating to the layout and construction of, and equipment in, slaughterhouses]_
(N)_[Article 15(1) and Annex III relating to handling and restraining operations]_
(O)_[Article 15(2) relating to restraint of animals killed in accordance with religious rites]_
(P)_[Article 15(3) relating to prohibited methods of restraint]_
(Q)_[Article 16(1) to (4) relating to monitoring procedures]_
(R)_[Article 17(1) to (5) relating to the Animal Welfare Officer]_
(S)_[Article 19 relating to emergency killing]_

in that **(..SPECIFY CONTRAVENTION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 30(1)(g) and 33(1) of the Welfare of Animals at the Time of Killing (England) Regulations 2015.

english.notes: Contravention of a provision in Schedule 5 to the regulations is an offence except where it is not necessary to comply with the provision by virtue of (i) an exemption or transitional provision specified in the EU Regulation; or(ii) a derogation granted by the competent authority under Article 18(3) in relation to a depopulation operationFor contravention of Article 3, please use H19058

other.penalty:
Summary: Fine

Time limit for prosecutions
6 monthsNote
Note that for offences committed since 12 March 2015, section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012 removes the limits on certain fines given by the Magistrates' Courts. Offences that were previously punishable by fines of 'prescribed sums' and that were limited to 'not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale' or 'not exceeding the statutory maximum', are now punishable by a fine of any amount.
